title: The Bottom of the Stair
description: Orrin Bly's slate has a column for how deep, and the deepest number on it is four. He has been leaving room under it for nine years.

go_to_the_bottom.title: As far down as it goes
go_to_the_bottom.objective: Reach the fifth floor of the Undervault and come back to tell Orrin Bly.
go_to_the_bottom.journal: Bly writes down who goes down and who comes up, and beside it how deep they say they got. The deepest figure on the slate is a four, entered six years ago by a woman who did not go down again. He wants to know whether there is a bottom or whether the stair just keeps offering.

told_him.title: There is a bottom
told_him.journal: Five floors, and below the fifth the stair does not offer. Bly ruled a line under the four, wrote the five beneath it, and then sat for a while without writing anything else.
